entities.name: Gryffid
entities.description: An elvish hunter of the Gilt-Leaf tribe, once Rhys's friend, who becomes an eyeblight, serves Nath and Eidren, and sacrifices himself in Cayr Ulios.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Gryffid's former friend and comrade, stripped of rank and branded a kin-slayer.

entities.name: Nath
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf taercenn disfigured at Porringer Valley; he makes Gryffid his second-in-command and is killed by Rhys.

entities.name: Eidren
entities.description: New taercenn and later Wilt-Leaf Vigilant who sacrifices his life to protect Mistmeadow.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Rhys's treefolk mentor.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Rhys's companion, a faerie ally who banishes Gryffid with magic and later helps defeat Oona.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Faerie queen whose pact with the Wilt-Leaf drains Cayr Ulios's elf magic.

entities.name: Kiel
entities.description: Ally who arrives and outnumbers the elves, helping Rhys stop Gryffid.

entities.name: Sapling
entities.description: Companion of Rhys on the mission to destroy Oona.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: Companion of Rhys on the mission to destroy Oona.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: The elvish tribe of Lorwyn.

entities.name: Wilt-Leaf
entities.description: The Shadowmoor elvish counterpart served by Gryffid; king and queen reside in Cayr Ulios.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: Maralen's faerie allies.

entities.name: Hemlock pack
entities.description: Pack led first by Rhys then Gryffid.

entities.name: Porringer Valley
entities.description: Site of the boggart feast massacre that blights Gryffid.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: Where Gryffid and Nath ambush Rhys during the Festival of Tales.

entities.name: Mistmeadow
entities.description: Site of a battle where Eidren sacrifices himself.

entities.name: Cayr Ulios
entities.description: Wilt-Leaf city where Gryffid dies breaking Oona's link.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Place Gryffid's team is sent to protect.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The bright plane of the first half of the story.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The dark transformed plane.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The event that transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Festival of Tales
entities.description: Festival during which Rhys is ambushed.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Goblins attacked by the elves.

events.summary: In 4520 AR Gryffid, second-in-command of Rhys's Hemlock pack, warns him against nonstandard tactics in a raid on boggarts; Rhys is stripped of rank and Gryffid becomes pack leader.
events.quote: Gryffid was elevated to leader of their pack.

events.summary: Gryffid leads the assault on a boggart feast in Porringer Valley; Rhys's yew magic backfires, killing most elves; Gryffid is one of three survivors, left an eyeblight.
events.quote: Gryffid was one of only three survivors from the ill-fated attack and was discovered by Nath.

events.summary: Nath offers Gryffid a choice; Gryffid swears allegiance to Nath, becomes his second-in-command, and they agree to eliminate Rhys.
events.quote: Gryffid swore allegiance to Nath and became his second-in-command.

events.summary: During the Festival of Tales they ambush Rhys in Kinsbaile; Rhys escapes and Gryffid is banished by Maralen's magic.
events.quote: was quickly banished from the battlefield by Maralen's magic.

events.summary: Rhys kills Nath; Gryffid finds the corpse, arranges a funeral pyre and swears vengeance on Rhys.
events.quote: ending with Nath's death at the hands of the outlaw traitor.

events.summary: Gryffid comes to respect his new commander Eidren and hunts Rhys until the Great Aurora; when he catches Rhys, Eidren offers Rhys a return to the Gilt-Leaf.
events.quote: When he finally caught Rhys, Eidren dismissed Gryffid and made Rhys an offer to return to the Gilt-Leaf

events.summary: At Mistmeadow Gryffid sees fae carry Rhys away at Maralen's orders; Eidren sacrifices his life, and Gryffid brings his remains to Cayr Ulios.
events.quote: When Eidren sacrificed his life to protect Mistmeadow

events.summary: At Cayr Ulios the Wilt-Leaf royalty elevate Gryffid to First Vigilant; persuaded by Oona's demonstration, he agrees to protect Glen Elendra.
events.quote: elevated him to the rank of First Vigilant.

events.summary: Gryffid's troops ambush Rhys, the Sapling and Ashling; Rhys talks him out of attacking and Gryffid hurries to protect Cayr Ulios.
events.quote: Rhys talked Gryffid out of attacking

events.summary: Gryffid finds the king and queen suspended by Oona's vines and sacrifices himself to sunder the main link, immolating himself and the royal pair and depriving Oona of Cayr Ulios's magic.
events.quote: When he sundered the main vine, the surge of magical energy immolated him along with the king and queen.

relations.quote: Originally a close friend and comrade to Rhys

relations.note: Swore allegiance and became his second-in-command.
relations.quote: Gryffid swore allegiance to Nath and became his second-in-command.
ending with Nath's death at the hands of the outlaw traitor.
under the command of Vigilant Eidren
Rhys' companion Maralen and her faerie allies

relations.note: Swore to hunt Rhys down for Nath's death.
relations.quote: swore that he would hunt Rhys down and get revenge for Nath's death
